## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      4 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 02.08.2026 - 14.10.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Michael Nevradakis_, 14.10.2026, 1/5: "2026 update: Frequently freezes/stops working on my Android phone, often requiring a force stop, or in some cases, reinstallation. Notes don't always sync, or sync quickly, from other devices. Even when "working," app often slow. I'm a pair customer and the price isn't cheap. Do better."
            2. _Kay Coughlin_, 13.10.2026, 1/5: "Edited 10.13.26: newest version of app does not let me access anything except keyboard. I can't access camera or import files. I can't even bold text or put in a bulleted list. Evernote is an amazing service. It has become my brain's external memory. I have been a premium user for many, many years and only recently have bugs become this serious. I use the app all day long, every day. What's going on, Evernote?!"
            3. _Stephen Chrusch_, 11.10.2026, 1/5: "Have been using Evernote for 8 years. Initially, a very good note taking app - unlimited notes, easy organization, a great study tool. It still is a good app at heart, but now almost completely unusable due to incessant advertising asking you to buy the full version (which is way overpriced). You can no longer add more than 50 notes on the free version, and you have to watch a video ad every time you want to look at your notes. I cant recommend this when there are better options out there"
<!--/ir-theme-->
